name: Wan Yu-Qing
source:
The only child of Wan Zi-Jin. She grew up in Indonesia and goes to a local Chinese school.

Yu-Qing is a wonderful child to her dad, but does not treat other people kindly.

Her nickname, Papaya, is given by her best friend Cocoa. 

She likes to draw, mostly about her ideal family.

"Daddy sent me to school. Daddy gives me food.
Daddy gave me a big house with my own room.
But Daddy, do you really love me?
Or am I just one of your pets, like a little dog or cat?"

[Edited from [url=http://www.erotes-studio.com/MayJasmine_english/03.html]official website[/url]]
